entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That's the death certificate of the[n]principal offender, correct? Is there[n]a problem with it?

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: More importantly, you've done well[n]with regard to the prosecutors.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: The cause of death for the SIU director[n]has been settled as a "stroke."

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: I had him work quite substantially on[n]forging evidence.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It was thanks to his efforts that I could[n]enter the phantom thief's interrogation[n]room too.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: The SIU is in disarray with his death.[n]I'll take my time choosing a successor[n]after the elections...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: At any rate, I'm now praised as a hero,[n]and I owe it all to the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Shido
entries.en: All possible hindrances are now gone.[n]There's no doubt that this election is[n]mine.
